opening.argument: The video is an informational Hearthstone Support segment led by the game's director, explaining the game's mechanics, cards, progression, and planned features. It places the Classic Set within the game's baseline Warcraft fantasy and discusses ordinary places where players can learn more about Hearthstone. The reward-related post is presented as part of an in-game progression system: players receive rewards through level 60. Nothing described asks viewers for payment, credentials, or participation outside the game. The closing makes the format clear: a question-and-answer discussion intended to address player questions. Taken together, the material is game-focused explanation and operational guidance, not a financial or data-collection solicitation.

citations.quote: I'm the Game Director on Hearthstone and welcome to Hearthstone Support!
The Classic Set is meant to set the baseline fantasy of Warcraft in the Hearthstone universe.
you do get rewards all the way up to level 60
Thanks for watching! I hope I answered your questions. This has been Hearthstone Support with Wired.
